PROBLEM
------------------------------
You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''
All provided problems CAN be solved.
You must give your solution in form of a sequence of allowed actions, separated by commas.
You must give only the sequence of actions, without any additional text or explanation.
You must enclose your solution inside the tags <plan> </plan>.
The following is an example of a Sokoban problem and its solution:
Problem:
#####
#@ ##
## $ ##
# #
##. ##
## #
###
Solution:
<plan>
R ,R ,D ,D
</plan>

Here is the Sokoban problem to solve, enclosed in triple backticks:
'''
###
#.#
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #

# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
#$#
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #

FINAL-PLAN
------------------------------
<domain>
(define (domain sokoban)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types location direction)
  (:predicates
    (at_player ?l - location)
    (at_box ?l - location)
    (is_clear ?l - location)
    (adjacent ?l1 - location ?l2 - location ?d - direction)
  )

  (:action move
    :parameters (?from - location ?to - location ?dir - direction)
    :precondition (and 
      (at_player ?from) 
      (adjacent ?from ?to ?dir) 
      (is_clear ?to)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (at_player ?from)) 
      (at_player ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action push
    :parameters (?p_at - location ?b_at - location ?b_to - location ?dir - direction)
    :precondition (and 
      (at_player ?p_at) 
      (at_box ?b_at) 
      (adjacent ?p_at ?b_at ?dir) 
      (adjacent ?b_at ?b_to ?dir) 
      (is_clear ?b_to)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (at_player ?p_at)) 
      (at_player ?b_at) 
      (not (at_box ?b_at)) 
      (at_box ?b_to) 
      (is_clear ?b_at) 
      (not (is_clear ?b_to))
    )
  )
)
</domain>

================================================================================


DOMAIN
------------------------------
(define (domain sokoban)
  (:requirements :strips :typing)
  (:types location direction)
  (:predicates
    (at_player ?l - location)
    (at_box ?l - location)
    (is_clear ?l - location)
    (adjacent ?l1 - location ?l2 - location ?d - direction)
  )

  (:action move
    :parameters (?from - location ?to - location ?dir - direction)
    :precondition (and 
      (at_player ?from) 
      (adjacent ?from ?to ?dir) 
      (is_clear ?to)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (at_player ?from)) 
      (at_player ?to)
    )
  )

  (:action push
    :parameters (?p_at - location ?b_at - location ?b_to - location ?dir - direction)
    :precondition (and 
      (at_player ?p_at) 
      (at_box ?b_at) 
      (adjacent ?p_at ?b_at ?dir) 
      (adjacent ?b_at ?b_to ?dir) 
      (is_clear ?b_to)
    )
    :effect (and 
      (not (at_player ?p_at)) 
      (at_player ?b_at) 
      (not (at_box ?b_at)) 
      (at_box ?b_to) 
      (is_clear ?b_at) 
      (not (is_clear ?b_to))
    )
  )
)

'''

+ - Player on Goal

* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''

The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''

Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.

The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.

'''
L - Move Left

# - Wall Brick

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''

PROBLEM
------------------------------
You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''
All provided problems CAN be solved.
You must give your solution in form of a sequence of allowed actions, separated by commas.
You must give only the sequence of actions, without any additional text or explanation.
You must enclose your solution inside the tags <plan> </plan>.
The following is an example of a Sokoban problem and its solution:
Problem:
#####
#@ ##
## $ ##
# #
##. ##
## #
###
Solution:
<plan>
R ,R ,D ,D
</plan>

Here is the Sokoban problem to solve, enclosed in triple backticks:
'''
###
#.#
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #
# #

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''
All provided problems CAN be solved.
You must give your solution in form of a sequence of allowed actions, separated by commas.
You must give only the sequence of actions, without any additional text or explanation.

'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.

The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''

You are an assistant that helps in solving assigned Sokoban games.
Your task is to examine the provided Sokoban problem and find a solution.
All provided Sokoban problems are assigned in form of ASCII maps.
The mapping is the following:
'''
@ - Player
+ - Player on Goal
$ - Box
* - Box on Goal
. - Goal ( Empty )
# - Wall Brick
'''
The game is solved when the box is pushed into the goal position, hence when the position of '$' coincides with the position of '.'.
The player can move in all the empty spaces of the ASCII map while respecting the walls.
When the player is adjacent to a box, the player can push the box into an adjacent empty space.
After pushing a box, the new position of the agent will be the position of the box before the push.
The player cannot pull the box, only push it.
The actions you can perform in the game are:
'''
L - Move Left
R - Move Right
U - Move Up
D - Move Down
'''
